description: This file defines the Java interface 'ScriptHelper' used within the OFBiz framework. The interface provides methods for script interactions such as entity lookups, service execution, logging, and error handling, acting as a helper or utility object for scripting purposes.

classes.name: ScriptHelper
classes.description: An interface that provides scripting helper methods for entity retrieval, service invocation, logging, and error handling within the OFBiz scripting framework.

methods.name: createServiceMap
methods.description: Extracts service IN parameters from the inputMap for a specified service, returning a map of parameters.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets the event/service status to error with a message.

methods.name: evalString
methods.description: Evaluates a string and returns the result.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sets the event/service status to failure with a message.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Returns a list of entity records matching given fields; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity record by primary key; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity record by primary key, using additional fields and arguments; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a new, empty entity value; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a new entity value with specified fields; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with input parameters; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with input parameters and additional arguments; throws ScriptException.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets the event/service status to success.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sets the event/service status to success with a message.
